measurement_boundary.cold: new resident model cache and new analysis output
measurement_boundary.hot: same in-process model pipeline, new analysis output
measurement_boundary.business_cache: same resident model and same output with unchanged files
measurement_boundary.real_mixed_pdf: same resident model after controlled phases; observations are not product facts
measurement_boundary.controlled_route_boundary: All three controlled visual reader results used ocr_fast. The cold-versus-hot delta mainly measures resident pipeline/model construction cost; it is not a Qwen generation-speed comparison.
measurement_boundary.post_benchmark_hardening: After timing, observation-only mode was hardened with a narrow explicit allowlist (weight, dimensions, quantity, model, material, color); electrical and capacity fields, low-confidence text, unknown units, same-OCR-line multiple values, and mixed input/output directions remain observations without Qwen or candidates. Schema-valid empty guided reviews now stop without a repeated deep call. Late-result rejection, reader-capability cache identity, stricter spatial grouping, nonzero-CropBox full-page fallback, and coordinate-space labels were also added. These changes are covered by model-free regression tests. The successful OCR routes measured above were not rerun, so these timings remain the final single-run measurements rather than performance claims for a new model process.
measurement_boundary.sample_size_warning: These are single runs on one machine, not latency distributions or accuracy guarantees.
